tv.label: CBS TV
tv.plot: Cybernetic Broadcasting System dominates 24/7 our galaxy for over a decade. This stream is noncommercial, unconventional and nothing like it can be encountered on any planet. You can run all you want, but there is no escaping CBS TV.

mtv.label: Murder Capital TV
mtv.plot: This stream is Murder Capital's TV channel. Delivering a mix of smut and exploitation B movies.

prctv.label: Panama Racing TV
prctv.tagline: Where The Meat Meets The Beat
prctv.plot: Lots of our own ninjas recorded at the Panama Racing Club and other places.

neon.label: Neon
neon.plot: Dreams of Neon transmits from Berlin offering streams from Neon studios and club nights by Lazercat, Naks and the Dreams of Neon residents.

austincassell.label: Austin Cassell
austincassell.plot: UK radio host and DJ specialising in braindance, experimental, old school techno and multigenre DJ sets. He has been part of the IFM krew since 2012 curating the very best of new music, classic tracks and exclusive guest sets. Previous guests include Wisp, Global Goon, NEZ, VLR and Impakt

elcamino.label: El Camino
elcamino.plot: Miqkael has been a DJ since 1997 and lived in Barcelona from 2000 until 2011, playing at Moog and other clubs. Since that time he has been also performing around Europe. Streaming from his Basque homeland, he shows you the way by mixing love and anger.

laniakea.label: Laniakea
laniakea.tagline: In the sunken city of R'lyeh, something is stirring
laniakea.plot: Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn.

mw.label: Magic Waves
mw.plot: Hailing from the UK, Magic Waves has been broadcasting since 2006. Known for underground music in their legendary regular Sunday night broadcasts, our team brings you music and culture from the future and past with the highest passion.

mtv2.label: Murder Capital TV 2
mtv2.plot: This stream is Murder Capital's TV second channel. Delivering a mix of smut and exploitation B movies.

reveal.label: REVEAL
reveal.plot: Official Intergalactic FM chapter in Utrecht. REVEAL is a streaming club for DJ sets, live performances and artists in residence.

radionul.label: Radio Nul
radionul.tagline: Cult, niche and do it yourself
radionul.plot: Radio Nul is a collaboration of various radio makers. Emphasis on cult, niche and do it yourself attitude. Radio programs and regular shows with different styles and approaches.

discotto.label: Discotto
discotto.plot: Streaming live and direct from the Woolwich triangle, London. Aural and visual stimulation from the studio featuring Discotto and guests.

shipwrec.label: Shipwrec
shipwrec.plot: Shipwrec Radio is a Nijmegen-based label which focuses on acid, electro, house and techno, with excursions into braindance, ambient and IDM. Featuring DJ Shipwrec, Camiel, Yash and sometimes guest DJs.

muledriver.label: Mule Driver
muledriver.tagline: Mule driving is not a crime
muledriver.plot: Live stream from Mule Driver's machine room
